content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(TIM Feed Attribution — GlobalProtect Scanning Infrastructure Match) AND BIOC(GlobalProtect Portal Probing Surge From a Single Source) share the same source_ip within a 3600s window AND the NGFW portal-probing surge precedes the first gateway-connected event on the matched exposed GlobalProtect edge asset — stitches the low-signal probe into one attributed exploit-precursor incident asserting reconnaissance preceded the CVE-2026-0257 authentication-bypass attempt.
rules.name: TIM-Attributed GlobalProtect Recon-to-Exploit Precursor
